player_prompt.intro:
Nawe ngumdlali {player_id} ({piece}). Isitha ngu ({opp}).
Thumela imidlalo njengesi '[a2 a3]' (kusuka → kuya).
- Imidlalo yeqophelo iyinhlanganiso eyodwa eya phambili kwenye inkonzo eceleni eingenamuntu.
- Ukubamba kuyinqwaba ngaphezu kwenye inkonzo yejelele eyakhona inendlulisela kwenye inkonzo eingenamuntu eseqophelweni.
Inqwaba yalikhaya inika {score_per_capture} amaphoyinti.
Ummdlalo uphela emva kwe {max_moves} imidlalo noma lapho umdlali akhona emdlalweni ofanelekile.
